name: shinchan-comfort-corner
description: Shinchan Comfort Corner - Wholesome emotional support app featuring Kasukabe friends

scripts.build: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); fs.mkdirSync("public", {recursive: true}); ["index.html", "favicon.ico", "favicon.svg", "robots.txt", "screen.png"].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, "public/"+f); }); console.log("Build complete: public directory prepared");'
